segments.name: Hospitality
segments.description: Owns and operates hotels and resorts.
segments.evidence: Our operations are organized into three principal business segments: (i) Hospitality, which includes our Gaylord Hotels properties, our JW Marriott properties, the Inn at Opryland and the AC Hotel; (ii) Entertainment, which includes the entertainment and media assets comprising OEG; and (iii) Corporate and Other, which includes corporate expenses.
